title: ampelopsis brevipedunculata var. hancei
intro: Ampelopsis brevipedunculata var. hancei, commonly known as Hance's grape, is a plant species in the grape family (Vitaceae) native to southern China. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and providing antioxidant protection. The health benefits of Hance's grape include lowering blood pressure, improving lipid profiles, and reducing the risk of cardiovascular disease. The bioactive constituents present in Hance's grape include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as vasodilation, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
